points: Learn general beach safety [here](/safety)
Bring someone else with you
Notice or bring floatation devices beforehand

hazards.title: Significant drop off on access stairs
points: [Contact the council](mailto:environment@amrshire.wa.gov.au) if you anything looks unstable
Be careful on stairs and look out for drop offs
Look out for signs

informational.title: Crowds during certain surfing conditions
points: Avoid going during peak surfing conditions at Gas Bay when possible if you're not planning to surf

informational.title: National Park and shorebird populations
points: Be aware that there is a National Park south of Gas Bay Headland, and that shorebirds populations need to be looked after
Do not feed the birds
